'''Adela''' is a stablewoman in [[Toke Fearnim]]'s stable.

==Appearance==
Adela is a lanky woman with a pimply face.

==Activities==
When [[Matrim Cauthon]] goes to buy a horse for [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]], Adela and [[Hurd]] show him the horses for sale.
